description: Save a search (the same filters as search_jobs) to check later with get_new_matches. Use this when the user wants to follow a search over time. Each call saves another search. Nothing is emailed or sent on a schedule: new jobs are found only when get_new_matches is called. Do not use for a one-off search (search_jobs). Needs a signed-in BirJob job seeker account: the first call asks the user to sign in to BirJob and allow access.

category.description: A field of work, as for search_jobs.

city.description: A city or district of Azerbaijan, as for search_jobs.

country.description: AZ (default), UZ, KZ, TR, GE or KG.

name.description: A short name for the saved search, e.g. "Python in Baku". Made from the filters if left out.

query.description: Words in the job title or company name, as for search_jobs.

remote.description: Work format, as for search_jobs (default exclude).

salary_min.description: Lowest monthly pay in manat (AZN). Azerbaijan only.

name: create_job_alert

last_checked.description: ISO 8601. get_new_matches answers what reached BirJob after it.

title: Save a job search
